meta.topic: The QA Audit Checklist for Bulk Psyllium Sourcing

slides.headline: The QA audit checklist for bulk psyllium sourcing
slides.subhead: 5 parameters your supplier must prove before you sign.

slides.headline: Particle size distribution
slides.body: Mesh size sets hydration speed and viscosity behaviour during processing. 40 mesh: slow, high-viscosity gel. 100 mesh: near-instant hydration, capsule-fill grade.
slides.actionBody: Ask for a lot-specific sieve test in the COA.

slides.headline: Swelling volume dynamics
slides.body: The pharmacopeial swell-volume test is the standard indicator of water-binding capacity. Poor separation or excess milling heat lowers swell volume versus the monograph range.
slides.actionBody: Insist on the USP/EP swelling-volume method, not a visual estimate.

slides.headline: Moisture control under 10%
slides.body: Psyllium absorbs moisture readily; above 10% in transit, mould and microbial risk rise. Dry-air processing plus export bags with a food-grade inner liner protect the lot in transit.
slides.actionBody: Check lot-specific moisture value dated at or after packing.

slides.headline: Total ash limits
slides.body: Ash is the mineral residue left after combustion — a proxy for sand and soil contamination. Commercial food grade sits under 4.0%; high-purity USP grade under 3.0%.
slides.actionBody: Ask how the mill pre-cleans and de-stones raw seed.

slides.headline: The pre-shipment document pack
slides.body: Ask any supplier for these four documents before the container leaves port: lot-specific COA, phytosanitary certificate, fumigation certificate, certificate of origin.
slides.actionBody: Review draft copies before dispatch, not after.

slides.headline: Sourcing de-risked, direct from Siddhpur
slides.body: Lot-specific COA support, sample-first from 100 g, no MOQ wall for growth brands.

caption.primaryText: Five things a serious psyllium supplier should be able to prove before you sign: mesh size control, swelling volume against the pharmacopeial standard, moisture under 10% for transit, total ash under spec, and a complete pre-shipment document pack. Ask for the lot-specific COA before you commit, not after the container ships. RM Psyllium supports 100 g samples and COA review before any order — reach us at export@rmpsyllium.com.
